newsitem.title: USA: Two Navy fliers die in California crash.
newsitem.headline: Two Navy fliers die in California crash.

text.p: Two Navy fliers were killed when their two-seater training aircraft crashed in a southern California national forest, the military said Thursday.
A spokeswoman at the El Toro Marine Base, some 50 miles south of Los Angeles, said the men died Wednesday evening in the crash of their prop-driven Beech T-34 Mentor.
They had taken off from El Toro and were flying to the El Centro Naval Air Base, some 100 miles (160 km) to the southeast, near the Mexican border.
The wreckage of the plane was found in a remote area of the Cleveland National Forest, the spokeswoman said.
Local TV said the rugged area of the crash was criss-crossed with high-tension wires, but the cause of the accident has not been established.
